description_en: Creates or modifies a level-2 masking scenario
description_zh: 调用DsgSceneAddOrUpdateScene接口，新增或编辑二级脱敏场景
name: DsgSceneAddOrUpdateScene

fields.help_en:
The description.

Note: Specifying this parameter in the current version may return PARAMS.ERROR (400). Specify only the required sceneName and sceneCode fields
fields.help_zh:
描述。

注意：当前版本传入此参数可能返回 PARAMS.ERROR（400）。建议仅传入 sceneName 和 sceneCode 两个必填字段
fields.name: desc

fields.help_en:
The ID of the level-2 masking scenario.
If you do not specify this parameter, the current operation creates a level-2 masking scenario.
If you specify this parameter, the operation modifies the specified level-2 masking scenario. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786322.html operation to query the ID of the level-2 masking scenario
fields.help_zh:
二级脱敏场景ID。
不配置该参数：表示当前操作为新增二级脱敏场景。
配置该参数：表示编辑指定二级脱敏场景信息。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786322.html接口查询二级脱敏场景ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The ID of the E-MapReduce (EMR) cluster. Specify this parameter only when the masking scenario takes effect on an EMR engine
fields.help_zh: 若脱敏场景生效的数据范围为EMR引擎，此处需输入EMR集群ID。仅当使用EMR引擎时需配置该参数
fields.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the engine for which the masking scenario takes effect. Valid values:
ODPS: ODPS.ODPS
HOLO: HOLO.POSTGRES
EMR: EMR
fields.help_zh:
脱敏场景生效的引擎类型。取值如下：
ODPS：ODPS.ODPS
HOLO：HOLO.POSTGRES
EMR：EMR
fields.name: db_type

fields.help_en: The name of the engine instance for which the masking scenario takes effect
fields.help_zh: 脱敏场景生效的引擎实例名称
fields.name: project_name

fields.help_en:
The engine information for which the masking scenario takes effect.

Note: Specifying this parameter in the current version may return PARAMS.ERROR (400). Specify only the required sceneName and sceneCode fields
fields.help_zh:
脱敏场景生效的引擎信息。

注意：当前版本传入此参数可能返回 PARAMS.ERROR（400）。建议仅传入 sceneName 和 sceneCode 两个必填字段
fields.name: projects

fields.help_en:
The code of the level-1 masking scenario to which the level-2 masking scenario belongs. Valid values:
dataworks_display_desense_code: masking for display in Data Studio and Data Map
maxcompute_desense_code: masking at the MaxCompute engine layer
maxcompute_new_desense_code: masking at the MaxCompute engine layer (new)
dataworks_analysis_desense_code: masking for display in Data Analysis
fields.help_zh:
二级脱敏场景所属的一级脱敏场景Code。取值如下：
数据开发/数据地图展示脱敏：dataworks_display_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏：maxcompute_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏（新）：maxcompute_new_desense_code
数据分析展示脱敏：dataworks_analysis_desense_code
fields.name: scene_code

fields.help_en: The name of the level-2 masking scenario
fields.name: scene_name

fields.help_en:
The user group information for which the masking scenario takes effect.

Note: Specifying this parameter in the current version may return PARAMS.ERROR (400). Specify only the required sceneName and sceneCode fields
fields.help_zh:
脱敏场景生效的用户组信息。

注意：当前版本传入此参数可能返回 PARAMS.ERROR（400）。建议仅传入 sceneName 和 sceneCode 两个必填字段
fields.name: user_group_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
